response: There is no significant difference in post-operative femoral version or percentage of excessive femoral version (DFV>15°) after intramedullary nailing of diaphyseal femur fractures between surgeons with trauma fellowship training and those without. However, it's essential to note that more complex cases are often left for trauma-trained surgeons, which may introduce bias into the comparison. To make a definitive conclusion, prospective data that accounts for this bias is necessary.
